open_points.subject: plan_run mapped-node conclusion
open_points.text: a skipped_by_guard or upstream_failed record concludes its node so, a function node and an operation node alike — for an operation element through the ElementFailed with that status operation_element_conclusion answers, as said above: skipped_by_guard concludes the node skipped and upstream_failed concludes it upstream_failed;
open_points.other_text: a mapped node concludes only when every element concluded, succeeded only when all succeeded.
open_points.question: Does one skipped_by_guard or upstream_failed element record immediately conclude a mapped node, or must the mapped node remain unconcluded until every element has concluded?
